name: Infoblox — Third C2 Domain Resolves Successfully (New Infrastructure)
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = infoblox_infoblox_raw
| filter xdm.event.type = "DNS Response" and xdm.event.outcome = "SUCCESS"
| filter xdm.event.description contains "c2-infra" or xdm.event.description contains "command-control"
| filter xdm.source.ipv4 != null
| alter domain = arrayindex(regextract(xdm.event.description, "query: (\S+) IN"), 0)
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as resolves by xdm.source.ipv4, domain, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, domain
description: Infoblox DNS NOERROR response for a domain containing 'c2-infra' or 'command-control' — third domain attempt succeeds (not yet on threat-intel feeds).
alert_name: Infoblox — Third C2 Domain Resolves Successfully (New Infrastructure)
alert_description:
What fired: Infoblox DNS NOERROR response for a domain containing 'c2-infra' or 'command-control' — third domain attempt succeeds (not yet on threat-intel feeds).

Why it matters: a host is communicating with known-bad or anomalous infrastructure (C2 / malicious domain). Assessed severity: High.

MITRE ATT&CK: T1071.004 - Application Layer Protocol: DNS (TA0011 - Command and Control).

Investigate:
  - Identify the internal client and the domain/IP contacted, and check reputation + resolution history.
  - Look for the initial delivery vector (email/web/download) and any beaconing cadence or follow-on payloads from the same host.
  - Pivot on the alert's key entity (xdm.source.ipv4) to related activity in the same window.
  - Confirm the activity is not expected/authorized for the involved entity before escalating.
